investigations.name: Stadtwerke Ribnitz-Damgarten GmbH

evidence.publicAFIR: Vaylens/Mobilithek current operator inventory: 5 sites / 18 EVSE, all 22 kW AC, all observed anonymous ad-hoc energy price 0.77 EUR/kWh.

investigations.name: Stadtwerke Bühl GmbH
investigations.decision: remain partial; chargecloud/Mobilithek estate now bounded

evidence.publicAFIR: chargecloud via Mobilithek enumerates 10 sites / 47 EVSE. AC is 0.48 EUR/kWh on 42/42 with zero start fee and 0.06 EUR/min blocking from minute 181 on inspected records. DC/HPC records expose zero start fee and 0.10 EUR/min blocking from minute 46.
evidence.conflict: Recent rendered records expose 0.59 EUR/kWh for inspected 50 kW DC and 180 kW HPC, while current operator aggregation rounds/reports DC/HPC up to 0.60 EUR/kWh.

investigations.exactGap: A 0.59 vs 0.60 EUR/kWh conflict remains on DC/HPC. Do not promote until the current raw chargecloud/Mobilithek payload deterministically resolves exact per-EVSE values for all five DC/HPC EVSEs.
investigations.resumeCondition: Retrieve current raw Mobilithek/chargecloud records for all 47 EVSE, especially the five DC/HPC EVSEs, and verify fee fields.
